title: 第七章 剑道传承第八章 狂妄嚣张
content_zh:
第七章：剑道传承苏命能感应到，吸收这两具尸体精魄所转化的灵气，大概相当于两颗灵石所带来的裨益。
但让他心中不解的是，自己上次杀张三和那名侍女的时候，却没有这种情况发生。
“难道说是因为之前那两人修为太弱的原因？”
就在苏命思索之际，死神塔上忽然闪烁乌光。伴随着一阵剧烈的吸力，随后，苏命的意识便来到了塔内。
无尽星河之上，女帝白玄清背对苏命，淡淡开口：“你杀了那两名侍卫，就不怕暴露？”
白玄清一身长裙，气质却依旧是那么清冷，就如同一朵冰山之上的雪莲，可远观不可亵玩。
苏命轻笑一声：“我苏命可不是一个坐以待毙的人，他们都要杀我了，我自然不会放过他们。”
“那你有没有想过后果？”白玄清转身看着苏命：“这件事最多明天就会暴露，以你那二娘的性子，她绝不会放过你的。”
“那我还能怎么办？”苏命摊了摊手道：“兵来将挡，水来土掩。总之一句话，谁想杀我，我就杀谁。”
白玄清嗤笑一声：“还谁想杀你你就杀谁？就凭你那筑基九层的实力？”
苏命尴尬挠头：“我这里还有一张一百灵石的灵票，兑换之后，应该够我突破到气海境。”
“别丢人现眼了！”白玄清挥手朝着苏命眉心打出一道神光：“我传你一道剑道入门传承，帮你变强一些，免得你不明不白的死在这里。”
脑海中传来一阵眩晕感，回过神的苏命顿时发现记忆中多了一道晦涩的传承记忆。
“你……”苏命有些意外地看着白玄清道：“你不是死神塔第一层的守关人吗，为什么要帮我？”
白玄清轻轻一笑，周围的星河仿佛都在她笑容面前黯然失色。
“传承是死的，人是活的。不过是区区传承而已，你以为你获得了我的传承就能击败我？”
感受着白玄清眼底那抹鄙夷，苏命虽说不服，却又无可奈何。
这就是来自女帝的压迫，不爽，但事实是你确实拿她没办法。
上前拍了拍苏命肩膀，白玄清安慰道：“别气馁了，被我打击不算丢人。现在的你，还是老老实实研习一下我传给你的东西，也让我看看，你的剑道天赋究竟如何。”
苏命点头盘坐下来，闭目，传承如流水一般流过他脑海。

脑海中这道传承记忆虽说晦涩深奥，但自己感悟下来，却让苏命如痴如醉，沉迷其中。
某一瞬，他仿佛推开了一个崭新的浩大世界，他的心神完全沉入其中，顷刻间，他便陷入了一个玄之又玄、物我两忘的意境。
“咦！”看着眼前的苏命，白玄清绝美的脸上露出一抹诧异之色：“居然这么快就陷入了顿悟的境地，我倒真是有些小瞧你了。”
时间一分一秒过去！
……
……
一个时辰后，苏命身上骤然迸发出一阵巨大的轰鸣。
一股凌冽的气息在苏命体外萦绕，盘旋。
“嗡！”
随着一声巨响，那道气息瞬间凝聚，化为一柄透明的长剑悬浮在苏命头顶。
也是在这一刻，苏命睁开了双眼。
令人诧异的是，此刻苏命的眼睛已不再是正常模样，他的眼瞳化作了一柄黝黑的长剑，看起来极为神异。
白玄清瞳孔微微放大，喃喃道：
content_en:
Chapter 7: Swordsmanship inheritance Su Ming can sense that the spiritual energy transformed by absorbing the essence of these two corpses is roughly equivalent to the benefits brought by two spiritual stones.
But what puzzled him was that the last time he killed Zhang San and the maid, this didn't happen.
"Is it because the two people before were too weak in cultivation?"
Just as Su Ming was thinking, a black light suddenly flashed on the Tower of Death. Following a violent suction, Su Ming's consciousness came to the tower.
Above the endless galaxy, Empress Bai Xuanqing turned her back to Su Ming and said calmly: "You killed those two guards, aren't you afraid of being exposed?"
Bai Xuanqing was wearing a long skirt, but her temperament was still so cold, just like a snow lotus on an iceberg, which could not be viewed from a distance.
Su Ming chuckled: "I, Su Ming, am not a person who just waits to be killed. They are going to kill me, so naturally I won't let them go."
"Then have you thought about the consequences?" Bai Xuanqing turned and looked at Su Ming: "This matter will be exposed tomorrow at most. With the temperament of your second mother, she will never let you go."
"Then what else can I do?" Su Ming spread his hands and said, "The soldiers will block it, and the water will cover it. In a word, I will kill whoever wants to kill me."
Bai Xuanqing sneered: "You will kill whoever wants to kill you? Just with your ninth-level foundation building strength?"
Su Ming scratched his head in embarrassment: "I also have a spirit ticket worth one hundred spirit stones here. After redeeming it, it should be enough for me to break through to the Qi Sea Realm."
"Don't be embarrassed!" Bai Xuanqing waved his hand and shot a divine light towards Su Ming's eyebrows: "I will pass on an introductory inheritance of swordsmanship to you to help you become stronger, so that you will not die here inexplicably."
There was a feeling of dizziness in his mind, and when Su Ming came back to his senses, he suddenly found that there was an obscure inherited memory in his memory.
"You..." Su Ming looked at Bai Xuanqing in surprise and said, "Aren't you the gatekeeper on the first floor of the Tower of Death? Why are you helping me?"
Bai Xuanqing smiled softly, and the surrounding stars seemed to pale in front of her smile.
"Inheritance is dead, but people are alive. It's just a mere inheritance. Do you think you can defeat me because you have my inheritance?"
Feeling the contempt in Bai Xuanqing's eyes, although Su Ming was not convinced, there was nothing he could do.
This is the oppression from the empress, which is unpleasant, but the fact is that there is really nothing you can do against her.
Stepping forward and patting Su Ming on the shoulder, Bai Xuanqing comforted him: "Don't be discouraged. It's not a shame to be hit by me. Now you should study the things I passed on to you honestly, and let me see what your swordsmanship talent is."
Su Ming nodded and sat down cross-legged, closing his eyes, and the inheritance flowed through his mind like water.
Although this inherited memory in his mind was obscure and profound, Su Ming was fascinated and obsessed with it when he realized it.
At a certain moment, he seemed to have opened up a new vast world, and his mind completely sank into it. In an instant, he fell into a mysterious and mysterious artistic conception, forgetting both things and myself.
"Eh!" Looking at Su Ming in front of him, a look of surprise appeared on Bai Xuanqing's beautiful face: "You fell into a state of enlightenment so quickly. I really underestimate you."
Time passes by minute by minute!
…
…
An hour later, a huge roar suddenly erupted from Su Ming's body.
A sharp aura lingered and hovered outside Su Ming's body.
"Buzz!"
With a loud noise, the aura condensed instantly and turned into a transparent long sword floating above Su Ming's head.
It was also at this moment that Su Ming opened his eyes.
What is surprising is that at this moment, Su Ming's eyes no longer look normal. His pupils turned into a dark long sword, which looked extremely magical.
Bai Xuanqing's pupils dilated slightly and murmured:
